text:
Over a special opening, the evening shift flagged an idea about travel paperwork, and we are sorry to learn that your recent experience with Aurelia Skyways was slowed by missing guidance, uncertain handling of the pet file, and the stress that followed for you and your companion animal.

We take this complaint seriously, and we are treating it as an operations matter that requires immediate correction. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is reviewing the record with the passenger coordinator and the cabin team so we can identify where the chain of handling weakened and why the expected support did not reach you in a clear and timely manner. When a traveler is preparing to fly with an animal, every required step must be communicated in a plain and orderly way, and every handoff must be controlled so the traveler is not left to guess at the process.

Your report has also been shared with a supervisor, because concerns about animal travel require close attention and a calm response. We understand that this kind of disruption can make a journey feel unsafe and unfair, especially when a pet is involved and confidence in the desk is reduced. We are sorry for that experience, and we are acting to prevent a repeat by tightening the review of passenger notes, reinforcing the check of companion animal documents, and reminding staff to escalate uncertainty instead of allowing it to pass.

If any part of the filing was incomplete, we will work to resolve it through the proper desk channel and restore confidence in the arrangements. If there was confusion in the transfer of your case, we will address it directly with the personnel involved and correct the workflow. Our aim is to provide steady support from the first contact through boarding, with the cabin team prepared to monitor the animal appropriately and the office team prepared to answer concerns without delay.

Please accept our formal apology and our commitment to urgent follow-up. We value the trust placed in Aurelia Skyways, and we are moving now to strengthen the service you should have received.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
